name: Nine of Swords
meaning_for_today: Today, events may seem like a nightmare, but they are driven by a guilty conscience. In reality, the day doesn't bring any real negativity. Any difficulties are just temporary circumstances. Gather your courage and accept the situation as it is. If you feel guilty about something, you should confess or repent. Under the influence of this Arcana, you become overly sensitive and can easily give in to stress and depression.
card_advice: A person under the influence of this card tends to be overly anxious and see events in a darker light than they actually are. It is necessary to eradicate this harmful trait. However, this doesn't mean you shouldn't trust your intuition and common sense. Your inner voice can suggest the right ways to solve problems, so it is worth listening to. Only focus on the positive side. Walk away from your fears and doubts, and don't dwell on your problems. Do not isolate yourself; it is crucial to share your feelings, thoughts, and worries so that the weight of these problems doesn't crush you.

upright.general: The card is characterized by anxieties, misfortunes, panic, and a sense of guilt. The root cause of all the problems happening in a person's life is primarily their helplessness in the face of failures. However, they cannot be blamed for having baseless fears and worries. Along with serious problems, minor difficulties may also arise that truly do not deserve attention. Troubles will occur, but one shouldn't forget that some of them are already in the past. The person will be tormented by bad premonitions firmly rooted in their subconscious. Additionally, they will feel shame for their actions. While the card doesn't carry a literal threat, it is psychologically very heavy, bringing fear, anxiety, sadness, and anguish. Enemies may appear in life, though due to their own actions, the person is often their own worst enemy. They fear their problems and hide their head in the sand.
upright.in_love: Heartlessness and cruelty manifest in relationships. Such inhumane actions are possible on an emotional level. There is a risk of losing a loved one. Extreme feelings are observed, where it is just one step from love to hate, and vice versa. The person to whom this Arcana falls often lives in anxiety, worrying about their future, and certain aspects of their partner's behavior might leave them in a state of shock. The card can even indicate revenge; if one partner doesn't forgive the other, they may harbor a grudge and even cause harm.
upright.in_situation: A person with the Nine of Swords often feels discomfort, which can arise in many situations, especially regarding working in a team. At any sign of difficulty, they will panic. This card appears for someone who lacks self-confidence or simply dislikes their job. It doesn't mean the affairs are completely hopeless, but luck will turn away from the person in certain moments. In most cases, they themselves will be to blame because they act restricted, frequently doubt that they are in the right field, and don't even try to show their talents, which they certainly possess. It describes an uncommunicative, pessimistic, and dishonest person who is not ready to cope with extreme situations.

reversed.general: The reversed card indicates that there is no reason for worry and that changes for the better are coming. A person gets an opportunity to learn to dream again. Although it cannot be called completely positive—since current problems require a logical conclusion and complete cloudlessness is out of the question—the person will perform hard work, and loss, slander, or limitations are possible. It can also indicate nightmares, ruined moods, and frequent states of sadness and grief. This depressed and sad mood can be linked to the absence of loved ones whose support is deeply needed.
reversed.in_love: Problems are present in the relationship between two people. The querent's state of mind is restless, but the time when everything will be fine again is not far off. It is possible that the person is experiencing stress, disagreements, and slander, but the time is coming when they will simply get rid of all of it. Perhaps, thanks to this card, the person will draw the right conclusions about what happened in their life and never repeat their mistakes. Kindness will guide their words and actions and will ultimately triumph. Everything bad will remain in the past as an old memory and eventually stop troubling them altogether. Through their suffering, the person will achieve purification, realize everything, and admit their guilt. New hopes and faith in the best are highly possible.
reversed.in_situation: The card speaks of anger that a person feels toward coworkers. These aggressive emotions are connected to their work activities or personal business. It is possible that an ill-wisher has appeared in their life who will interfere with their affairs in every possible way. It is important not to lose composure in such a situation; it is better to involve influential people who can help significantly. It is absolutely necessary to listen to the advice of authoritative figures, even if it seems at first glance that one can handle it independently. Expect changes and new impressions, as they will surely happen.
